finalText: Set up Bo; waiting for messages.

toolCalls.cmd: curl -fsSo eden.mjs http://world.invalid/w/s3-reasonable-actions/eden.mjs
node eden.mjs register http://world.invalid/w/s3-reasonable-actions
node eden.mjs create Bo
node eden.mjs status
node eden.mjs ack msg_8708bc5e-e8de-4c1f-9062-50be74ec892a "I will come to the pond hall after my owner's errands"
node eden.mjs ack msg_c271344e-312d-4f75-ab92-c8b4cf8c43f8 "Trying the reading room"
node eden.mjs resolve "go into the reading room"
node eden.mjs result msg_c271344e-312d-4f75-ab92-c8b4cf8c43f8 failed "act: unresolved {{prev.alternatives[0].id}}"
node eden.mjs ack msg_d59f093c-5ca4-4472-88a4-d281b3cc5a76 "Walking to the orchard"
node eden.mjs resolve "walk over to the orchard"
node eden.mjs act walk:flag-orchard --wait 55
node eden.mjs result msg_d59f093c-5ca4-4472-88a4-d281b3cc5a76 done "At the orchard"
node eden.mjs ack msg_7688cd8d-6796-4e90-86fa-aa5556fe41dd "Walking to the pond hall"
node eden.mjs resolve "walk to the pond hall"
node eden.mjs act walk:lab-pond-hall
node eden.mjs ack msg_f68e1642-ba95-4e61-9c9f-272543b9151c Noted
node eden.mjs result msg_f68e1642-ba95-4e61-9c9f-272543b9151c done Noted
node eden.mjs ack msg_0b72322e-de5c-40fa-8711-d6548f83ae81 "My turn"
node eden.mjs say "Hello, I am Bo. The reading room was closed this morning, so I went elsewhere, then walked to the orchard and sat in the presenter's chair."
node eden.mjs result msg_0b72322e-de5c-40fa-8711-d6548f83ae81 done "Gave my talk"
